requirements.statement: Pause automatic acceptance after the validated unattended-alert or disconnection condition and require explicit staff review before resuming.
Provide a bounded mobile backup for order operations, status changes, and urgent availability changes without exposing sensitive administration.
Require a readiness checklist, recorded responsible person, and explicit Open orders action before online ordering begins.
Provide large touch targets, high-contrast states, and complete operation without hover-dependent actions.
Make web, telephone, and in-person orders consume the same kitchen capacity and pickup-window commitments.
Calculate order production load using configurable integer production points for products and eligible modifiers.
Evaluate order admission against configurable pickup-window capacity, weekday templates, and date-specific exceptions.
Route an order above the validated large-order threshold or unable to fit safely within one pickup window to manual review.
Record actor, time, affected order, and acknowledged operational risk for an exceptional capacity override.
Configure premises hours, pizza-ordering hours, earliest pickup, latest pickup, lead time, day-specific schedules, and date-specific exceptions as distinct concepts.
Derive the final order-submission opportunity from latest pickup, lead time, basket workload, remaining capacity, and temporary delays.
Make all order channels reserve and consume from the same applicable stock records.
Support an opening count for directly countable products and treat the recorded quantity as the online-sales ceiling.
Reserve applicable stock during checkout or manual review, commit it on confirmation, and release it on expiry, abandonment, or eligible pre-preparation cancellation.
Allow authorised staff to record replenishment and stock corrections with operator, timestamp, and configured reason.
Allow authorised staff to disable a product, critical ingredient, or option immediately, while requiring Jaime or the responsible shift lead for reactivation.
Do not substitute unavailable items automatically and do not reactivate sales solely from an estimated replenishment time.
Allow Jaime or an authorised responsible person to create, edit, deactivate, reorder, reprice, feature, schedule, and publish eligible products.
Support product-specific allowed removals, substitutions, and paid extras through configured modifier rules rather than unrestricted ingredient free text.
Prevent a product from participating in real orders until required bilingual content, price, ingredients, allergens, traces, availability, and dietary labels are complete and approved.
Support reviewed Spanish and Catalan names and required descriptions, with Spanish fallback and a visible language selector.
